A '''spyglass''' is a zoom tool. [[Matcha Flavoured]] lets it be made with [[glass]].

== Obtaining ==
{{Recipes}}
A glass or amethyst shard above two [[Copper Ingot|copper ingots]] makes a spyglass; the vanilla recipe is removed.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/spyglass.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/pack.mcmeta}}</ref>
